\cvsection{Research interests}
I work on learning and planning for robot manipulation and whole-body control. My current research explores action abstractions from human motion capture for planning with learned world models, and Q-guided recovery for frozen imitation policies, toward reliable humanoid loco-manipulation.

\cvsection{Ongoing research projects}
\needspace{85pt}\textbf{Motion Abstractions for World-Model Planning}\hfill{\small Ongoing}\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=13pt,itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=3pt]
\item Investigating action abstractions learned from human motion capture that let a planner choose motion and duration using a learned world model, with reference trajectories tracked by a closed-loop controller.
\item Studying when these abstractions improve humanoid locomotion planning under matched time and compute budgets, toward long-horizon loco-manipulation.
\end{itemize}\par\addvspace{4pt}
\needspace{85pt}\textbf{Learning Recovery Proposals for Q-Guided Planning}\hfill{\small Ongoing}\par
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=13pt,itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=3pt]
\item Exploring lightweight, behaviorally diverse recovery proposals around a frozen imitation policy, selected by a shared task-value critic and retained at deployment.
\item Planning comparisons with Q-only selection, a single residual policy, and search without learned proposals to assess recovery, nominal-task performance, and repeated-search cost under matched interaction and compute budgets.
\end{itemize}\par\addvspace{4pt}
